ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - NirCmd Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of NirCmd tool for command execution, which could be the result of legitimate administrative activity

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\NirCmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "NirCmd\.exe") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ execmd\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ script\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ shexec\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ runinteractive\\ .*"))) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ exec\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ exec2\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ show\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ hide\\ .*")))
